_comment: GraphPlusContext — inject the live vault cursor into every Claude Code session at startup. Merge the 'hooks' key into ~/.claude/settings.json (do not replace the whole file). Replace __VAULT_PATH__ with your vault's absolute path; install.sh does this for you.

hooks.command: jq -n --rawfile boot "__VAULT_PATH__/boot.md" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("=== VAULT BOOT CURSOR (auto-injected at session start) ===\n" + $boot)}}' 2>/dev/null || true
